comment: Hand-curated catalog rows merged into kFallbackOnboardingModels at load (lib/server/constants.js). model-catalog-bootstrap.json is regenerated VERBATIM from the pinned CLI by scripts/refresh-model-bootstrap.mjs, which would erase hand edits — rows the pinned CLI does not emit live here instead. On a key collision the generated row wins (freshest-from-CLI beats hand-curated). Added for upstream PR #111: the 2026.7.1-2 CLI emits no direct minimax/minimax-cn rows.
